summary: Story 132.2 records the bounded remote Postgres production-readiness contract. SQLite remains the default; remote Postgres remains opt-in and production activation requires later operator evidence, backups, migrations, DB mTLS composition, and approval.

current_default_preservation.required_statement: SQLite remains the default runtime backend unless REGISTRY_DATABASE_URL is explicitly set by an operator-approved environment. Documentation does not activate remote Postgres.

opt_in_remote_postgres_runtime_support.sqlite_fallback_policy: unset or sqlite+aiosqlite URL preserves SQLite behavior
fail_closed_rules: remote postgres is never selected by default
non-asyncpg Postgres URLs are not production-ready for this contract
operator evidence is required before any production activation
no live database is provisioned by this story

bounded_pool_contract.sqlite_pool_policy: SQLite keeps its existing NullPool/local behavior

required_evidence: single migration runner identity and lock/election evidence
Alembic head/current revision evidence before and after migration
no registry-api or worker migration runner
rollback or fix-forward decision record for failed migrations
forbidden: production migration execution by this story

db_mtls_composition.activation_boundary: DB mTLS support alone does not activate remote Postgres production mode

required_evidence: sha256 checksum for backup artifact or provider snapshot identity
Postgres integrity check or logical consistency query evidence
integrity_checks: restored database accepts read-side health query
failed drill records rollback/fix-forward path instead of continuing

requirements: registry-api reads registry-state materialized tables through the shared SQLAlchemy session factory
registry-api task/event/session reads must work with the selected backend
registry-api must not run Alembic migrations
registry-api must not become a second state materializer
idempotency-cache write boundaries remain explicit and separate from registry-state materialization

non_goals: no live remote Postgres production activation
no production credentials or DSN values
no compose profile or overlay activation
fail_closed_checks: remote Postgres remains explicit opt-in only
bounded pool contract is exact: pool_size formula, max_overflow 5, pool_timeout 30, pool_recycle 1800, pre_ping true
Alembic has a single migration runner with pre-migration backup evidence
backup/restore drill requires checksum, integrity, and rollback/fix-forward evidence
registry-api read-side support is documented without creating a second migration/materialization writer
redaction forbids DSNs, passwords, private keys, paths, and hostnames
no live activation, provisioning, credentials, or overclaims are present
justfile and CI checker wiring is present
